Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 2, 7.4, 8.1; courts A/J. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M34JJ6YR2K714HPAPT8YTES6; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7A7VR2FS29XRP4QQ4A3V.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own AppCompiler source/provenance entry adaptation, reusing Edition validated and compileDraft paths. Remove fixture-only assumptions only for imports; keep linked WOG fixture provenance. Preserve semantic navigation, exact text, compilation outcomes and receipts.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Imported validated builds require their true receipt/basis; imported drafts expose supported Codex/Atlas findings and gaps without fixture authority.
2. An inspectable draft is not cast to AlignmentSource; consume the provider-ratified mapping-source relationship or refuse that capability.
3. Independent expected basis/receipt assertions and mutated missing/wrong build receipts distinguish imports, drafts and the built-in fixture.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep the standalone fixture/compiler wrapper and existing CLI draft reader; unsupported import refuses without promotion.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Compile imported and draft sources with truthful authority
